title: Credit Card Fraud Detection — Supervised Learning
summary: A fraud-detection benchmark for credit card transactions that compares classical ML, deep learning, and UMAP+DBSCAN clustering-based classifiers under multiple imbalanced-data resampling strategies. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata schema to generate synthetic oversampled fraud transactions as one of the tested sampling strategies.
